_learned_folds_doc: Learned by build_db.learn_folds: a series name no source knows that is a known series' name with noise around it (set words stripped, then equal to, or beginning or ending with, a known key). Applied when 80% of its dated files fall inside the target's run and at least half its dates are dates the spine, OTRR's log or the target's own files already have, and a name that only begins or ends with the series' has 3+ dates; never when undated, from LibriVox, or a re-creation. Move a wrong one to _rejected.
